Remarks.The candidates who qualify the Hindi Language, Typewriting and Stenography Examinations of the Hindi Teaching Scheme through own efforts will be eligible fo the above-mentioned benefits even if they secure 5% less marks than the prescribed percentage, while granting them the Cash Award in addition to Lumpsum award. - Order (1).
